# Sample incident-response runbook (test fixture)

This short document exists only to test document answers. It is not a real college's policy.

## Compromised account

If a student or staff account is suspected to be compromised, the on-call analyst disables the
account in the identity system within 30 minutes and forces a password reset. The analyst then
notifies the Director of Information Security by phone, and the account owner by their personal
email address on file. All sign-ins from the previous 14 days are reviewed for unfamiliar locations.

## Phishing reports

Reported phishing emails are forwarded to the security mailbox. If more than 20 people received the
same message, the analyst removes it from all inboxes and posts a warning on the campus status page.

## Lost laptop

A lost college laptop is reported to Campus Safety and to the help desk. The help desk locks the
device remotely. Laptops are encrypted, so no data notification is needed unless the device was
unlocked when lost.
